name: hotplug
about: Plugged and unplugged mid-song, one robot: it plays notes on cable 0 (routed back to its cable 1) and unplugs itself every 2 s for 300 ms. Messages around an unplug are counted as lost_unplugged, not loss; reconnect_ms is unplug-end to the host's mount. stuck_notes catches a note-on whose note-off was lost to the unplug (the P4 should release them).
